implementation: Independent implementation of selected concepts; embedded reference instructions not executed.

features.name: Command palette
features.implementation: Search sections, strategies and tools with Ctrl/Cmd+K.

features.name: Keyboard shortcut map
features.implementation: Ctrl/Cmd+K for commands; Alt+Shift+F for focus. Native editing shortcuts stay unchanged.

features.name: Saved searches
features.implementation: Save and reuse up to 20 catalogue searches.

features.name: Faceted search
features.implementation: Existing domain/tier/role filters plus a board status filter.

features.name: Customizable dashboard
features.implementation: Choose which local workspace widgets appear.

features.name: Focus mode
features.implementation: Hide navigation chrome while preserving a fixed exit control.

features.name: High contrast
features.implementation: High-contrast palette plus forced-colors support.

features.name: Reading typography
features.implementation: Adjust font size and line spacing without external fonts.

features.name: Interactive onboarding
features.implementation: Four optional guided tasks using the actual workspace.

features.name: Undo/redo history
features.implementation: Revert up to 25 session changes; destructive erase clears history.

features.name: Version differences
features.implementation: Inspect field-level changes and preview backups before restoring.

features.name: Workflow templates
features.implementation: Create a non-identifying programme workflow from selected strategies.

features.name: Goal-to-task hierarchy
features.implementation: Tasks link back to a selected public strategy.

features.name: Dependency graph
features.implementation: Inspect prerequisite relationships without mapping people.

features.name: Blocking detection
features.implementation: Prevents completion while a prerequisite is unfinished; cycles are rejected.

features.name: Responsibility matrix
features.implementation: Assign work to role categories, never named children or caseworkers.

features.name: Recurring tasks
features.implementation: Manually create the next weekly/monthly occurrence; no background scheduler.

features.name: Timeline
features.implementation: View dated programme tasks in chronological order.

features.name: Weighted comparison
features.implementation: Compare up to four strategies using explicit user-entered weights/ratings.

features.name: Scenario comparison
features.implementation: Compare budget contingencies and programme choices transparently.

features.name: Calculation provenance
features.implementation: Display calculation formulas, currency and assumptions.

features.name: Risk register
features.implementation: Track programme risks, mitigation, role responsibility and review dates.

features.name: Assumption registry
features.implementation: Track premises, how to check them and challenged assumptions.

features.name: Decision log
features.implementation: Record rationale and later outcomes.

features.name: Reversibility review
features.implementation: Flag decisions that are costly to reverse or need specialist review.

features.name: Review dates
features.implementation: Show overdue programme reviews locally; no notifications or auto-send.

features.name: Knowledge graph
features.implementation: Explore typed strategy/source/infrastructure links.

features.name: SVG export
features.implementation: Export the current public evidence diagram as a standalone vector.

features.name: Evidence tension links
features.implementation: Show short-term/long-term and informant differences without treating them as identical outcomes.

features.name: Multi-format export
features.implementation: Produce Markdown plans, CSV task/budget tables, SVG diagrams and iCalendar files.

features.name: Selective export
features.implementation: Choose public catalogue selections or specific programme tables.

features.name: Client-side encryption
features.implementation: Optional AES-GCM encrypted full backups with a user-held passphrase.

features.name: Identifier-warning scan
features.implementation: Flag some email/phone/identity phrases before export; explicitly incomplete.

features.name: Data inventory
features.implementation: Show counts and storage categories; backups remain local plaintext unless exported encrypted.

features.name: Storage quota inspection
features.implementation: Show browser-reported quota and usage on request.

features.name: Self-test dashboard
features.implementation: Run small local validation/protocol/CSV checks on request.

features.name: Diagnostic report export
features.implementation: Preview and download capability results; never send them.

features.name: Unified discovery
features.implementation: Search the source-linked catalogue and jump directly through commands.
